ui.conflict.after: Agree with the resolution? Resolve it above, in the temporary worktree (merge, never rebase; push without force only with your “yes”), or continue in Claude Code, in this same session.
ui.conflict.busy.reading: The agent is reading both sides of the conflict…
ui.conflict.job.label: Conflict for #{issue}
ui.conflict.opening: Explain the conflict: what each side changed, why it conflicts and the resolution you propose, with what to test afterwards.
ui.discussions.explaining: The agent is reading the code and the discussion…
ui.discussions.partialHint: partial answer: the agent stopped before finishing the investigation
ui.discussions.point: The point, according to the agent
ui.discussions.proposalNote: Each button only creates a proposal. Nothing goes to {vcsName} before the “go” and the confirmation on the Actions screen.
ui.discussions.stale: The discussion got new replies after this explanation.
ui.gate.busy.draw: The agent is drawing the visual aid…
ui.gate.busy.read: The agent is reading the section with you…
ui.gate.busy.round: The agent is building the new round…
ui.gate.busy.start: The agent is reading the artifact and building the quiz…
ui.gate.consolidation.intro: It is not a grade: it is a sign that the material did not teach. 1) The section is cited in each wrong question. 2) Assisted reading: {ask}. 3) A visual aid for the section. 4) A new round with new questions.
ui.gate.consolidation.title: Off target: consolidation cycle
ui.gate.empty: This activity has no Investigation, RFC, Functional Spec, Findings or Plan in .specs.
ui.gate.explain.draftPlaceholder: Ask about the point you missed
ui.gate.free.placeholder: Or answer in your own words (it is evaluated, not accepted as is)
ui.gate.job.insert: Visual inserted in the gate for #{iid}
ui.gate.lastAfterTwo: Two wrong rounds: the problem is the material. Rewrite the section (in Claude Code) and restart the quiz; if it still fails, you decide between an accepted risk in the Plan log or going back to F1/F2.
ui.gate.pick.intro: The agent reads the artifact, writes the Gate summary and asks up to 3 consequence questions. Approval is still your phrase in the Claude Code chat.
ui.gate.pick.title: Which gate?
ui.gate.question.title: Question {n} · {kind}
ui.gate.spoken.notAssertive: Quiz off target. Let's close the gap before the gate.
ui.gate.spoken.question: Question {n}. {text} {options}
ui.gate.verdict.assertive.intro: The gate opens with your phrase in the Claude Code chat ({phrase}). Save the record and continue in the session.
ui.gate.verdict.phrase.gate1: “investigation approved, create the Plan” or “RFC approved, go ahead”
ui.glossary.cap.kokoro: How to say it in Kokoro
ui.glossary.intro: Each term applies to both directions of the voice. {say} is what the voice pronounces in place of the term; empty, it reads the term as written. {kokoro} is the pronunciation for that voice only, which reads English words worse than Edge; empty, it uses {say}. {heard} are the wrong spellings the transcription tends to produce, separated by commas: they become the term. The terms are also sent to the recognizer as a vocabulary hint. On screen everything stays spelled the right way.
ui.glossary.listen.title: Listen to the pronunciation
ui.glossary.sample.heard: the Q&A cleared the merdi in the pipe line
ui.glossary.sample.spoken: web{crMark}202 is approved and QA clears the merge in the gateway.
ui.glossary.saved: Dictionary saved: {count} terms. It applies to the next speech and the next recording.
ui.glossary.saved_one: Dictionary saved: {count} term. It applies to the next speech and the next recording.
ui.glossary.saved_other: Dictionary saved: {count} terms. It applies to the next speech and the next recording.
ui.glossary.test.title: Test
ui.glossary.title: Term dictionary
ui.help.agentVoice.text: The “Voice on/off” button at the top of Today (and Settings › Voice) turns the agents’ speech on or off. When off, everything stays on screen and nothing goes to Edge.
ui.help.ceremonies.gate.text: The agent reads the phase artifact (Investigation, RFC, Functional Spec, Findings or Plan), writes the gate summary and asks up to 3 consequence questions. Approval is still your phrase in the Claude Code chat.
ui.help.ceremonies.hostOnly.text: Discussions walks through the open discussions of {anCr}. {vcsName} builds proposals (reviewer, draft and the like) for you to confirm in Actions.
ui.help.ceremonies.others.text: QA return explains an activity that came back from testing. Discussions walks through the open discussions of {anCr}. {vcsName} builds proposals (label, reviewer and the like) for you to confirm in Actions.
ui.help.ceremonies.qaHandoff.text: The agent explains to QA what changed and what to test. The checklist and the notice text for the team come out.
ui.help.ceremonies.radar.text: Read-only: it cross-checks the files of your open {crs}, from different activities, and warns about collisions.
ui.help.ceremonies.retro.text: Weekly. Gathers the last 7 days (rejections, blockers, conflicts, wrong quizzes and rework) and talks with the moderator about what to improve.
ui.help.ceremonies.retro.text.off-sdd: Gathers the last {retroDays} days (rejections, blockers, conflicts and rework) and talks with the moderator about what to improve.
ui.help.ceremonies.retro.text.own-retro: Gathers the last {retroDays} days (rejections, blockers, conflicts, wrong quizzes and rework) and talks with the moderator about what to improve.
ui.help.ceremonies.title: What each ceremony does
ui.help.ceremonies.unblock.text: An in-depth conversation about a stuck activity. The agent reads the spec, {vcsName} and playbook, and when there is context you ask for 2 to 3 ways out, each with its consequence.
ui.help.ceremonies.unblock.text.off-sdd: An in-depth conversation about a stuck activity. The agent reads the activity documents, {vcsName} and the project context, and when there is context you ask for 2 to 3 ways out, each with its consequence.
ui.help.cmd.deepen.text: Opens the Unblock of the current activity: an in-depth conversation with its agent. Anywhere in the sentence.
ui.help.cmd.next.text: Moves on to the next agent. On the last activity, it closes the agenda. It must be at the start of the sentence.
ui.help.data.intro: Everything is a local file; nothing goes to a server of ours.
ui.help.data.shared.text: What applies to all workspaces: browser access and paired devices, and the glossary. The conflict verification commands belong to each workspace (Settings › Conflict verification). In Settings › Workspaces you can create an empty workspace for real use and mark the current one as a test workspace: in it nothing leaves the machine (code host, the specs’ Plan, card notes).
ui.help.data.specs.text: Specs the app reads and, in the writes above, where it saves the Plan log, QA_CHECKLIST.md and the gate diagram.
ui.help.data.title: Where the data lives
ui.help.data.workspaces.text: Each workspace keeps its own copy of: the day’s minutes ({minutes}), {history} (each ceremony), {gates}, {qa}, {retros}, {activity}, {config} (Settings), {actions} (Actions), {cost}, {radar} and {status}.
ui.help.f1: Press {key} on any screen to open or close it.
ui.help.never.agents.text: They only read (files, playbook skills, {vcsName}). Editing files, accessing the web, reading secret files and writing to {vcsName} are always blocked, whatever the configuration.
ui.help.never.agents.text.off-sdd: They only read (files, skills, {vcsName}). Editing files, accessing the web, reading secret files and writing to {vcsName} are always blocked, whatever the configuration.
ui.help.never.effects.text: The effects queue runs nothing: each item goes to Claude Code, where it waits for your “yes”.
ui.help.never.gitlab.text: Never on its own. Everything it writes (comment, label, reviewer, merge of main into a branch and push) becomes an action on the Actions screen and only runs after your “Go” and a confirmation. The push is never a force-push.
ui.help.never.local.text: “Save minutes and decisions” saves the day’s minutes and takes only the marked decisions to the Plan log or to the card note. “Save to .specs” creates QA_CHECKLIST.md and “Insert into the artifact” puts the diagram in the gate document; both ask for confirmation.
ui.help.never.teams.text: Never. The text is generated and you copy and paste it.
ui.help.never.title: What the app never does on its own
ui.help.silence.text: With the option on, after you start speaking, a long pause sends the speech by itself. Each speech lasts 30 seconds at most. The default pause is 1200 ms and can be changed in Settings › Voice.
ui.help.space.text: Starts recording. Pressing it again sends the speech. It does not apply when focus is on a text field, button, list or link: there, space does what the control does.
ui.help.tab.text: They move from control to control; {enter} or {space} activates the focused button. The focus outline only shows for the keyboard.
ui.help.title: Help
ui.qa.busy.reading: The agent is reading the activity…
ui.qa.busy.rereading: The agent is rereading the activity…
ui.qa.prepare.intro: The agent reads the ISSUE_COMPLETION, the TEST_PLAN, the Plan, the {cr} diff and the QA note on the issue, and explains {by} what changed and what to test. The checklist and the notice text come out of here. Creating the release branch, the comment and the status stay in your team’s release tool, with “yes”.

ui.qa.take.text: Release branch, pipelines, the comment for QA and the testing status: your team’s release tool, with “yes” for each action.

ui.resolver.none.intro: Creates a temporary worktree from your local clone (your work in the clone is not touched), merges main into the branch and shows each conflicting hunk. Everything stays on your machine until you say “yes” to the push.

ui.resolver.publish.intro: Merge committed in the worktree ({commit}): “Merge branch '{target}' into '{branch}'”. Publishing runs {push}, fast-forward only, no force. Before pushing, the branch is fetched again and the push is refused if it changed since the preparation.
ui.resolver.publish.title: Publish
ui.resolver.published: Published to {branch}. The worktree was removed. The QA comment update shows up in Release actions, with its own “yes”.
ui.resolver.skipTests.hint: Applies and commits the merge without running anything. Check it only if you will test elsewhere.
ui.resolver.skipTests.label: Proceed without tests
ui.resolver.title: Resolve here
ui.resolver.verify.judge: Judge the output: main may have failures that already existed. The commit only happens if you ask for it.
ui.resolver.verify.skipped: Applied without tests, as you confirmed.
